verses.restored: Now the main point of what is being said: we have such a high priest, who sat at right hand of throne of Majesty in the heavens,

familiar.text: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

modern.text: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

verses.restored: minister of the holy places and of the true tent, which the Lord pitched, not a human.

familiar.text: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

modern.text: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.

verses.restored: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices; therefore it is necessary also for this one to have something to offer.

familiar.text: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

modern.text: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.

original.text: πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς τὸ προσφέρειν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας καθίσταται· ὅθεν ἀναγκαῖον ἔχειν τι καὶ τοῦτον ὃ προσενέγκῃ.

verses.restored: If indeed he were upon earth, he would not be priest, since there are those offering gifts according to Law,

familiar.text: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

modern.text: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.

original.text: εἰ μὲν ⸀οὖν ἦν ἐπὶ γῆς, οὐδʼ ἂν ἦν ἱερεύς, ⸀ὄντων τῶν προσφερόντων κατὰ ⸀νόμον τὰ δῶρα·

verses.restored: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, just as Moses was warned when about to complete the tent: See, he says, that you make all things according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.

familiar.text: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

modern.text: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.” The New Covenant (Jeremiah 31:26–40)

original.text: (οἵτινες ὑποδείγματι καὶ σκιᾷ λατρεύουσιν τῶν ἐπουρανίων, καθὼς κεχρημάτισται Μωϋσῆς μέλλων ἐπιτελεῖν τὴν σκηνήν, Ὅρα γάρ, φησίν, ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει)·

verses.restored: But now he has obtained a more excellent service, by as much as he is mediator of a better covenant, which has been legislated upon better promises.

familiar.text: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

modern.text: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.

verses.restored: For if that first had been faultless, no place would have been sought for a second.

familiar.text: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

modern.text: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.

original.text: Εἰ γὰρ ἡ πρώτη ἐκείνη ἦν ἄμεμπτος, οὐκ ἂν δευτέρας ἐζητεῖτο τόπος·

verses.restored: For finding fault with them, he says: Look, days are coming, says Lord, and I will complete upon the house of Israel and upon the house of Judah a new covenant,

familiar.text: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

modern.text: But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

original.text: μεμφόμενος γὰρ ⸀αὐτοὺς λέγει· Ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται, λέγει κύριος, καὶ συντελέσω ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα διαθήκην καινήν,

verses.restored: not according to the covenant that I made with their ancestors in the day of taking hold of their hand to lead them out of land of Egypt, because they did not remain in my covenant, and I disregarded them, says Lord.

familiar.text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

modern.text: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord.

original.text: οὐ κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν ἐποίησα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπιλαβομένου μου τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ὅτι αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἐνέμειναν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ μου, κἀγὼ ἠμέλησα αὐτῶν, λέγει κύριος.

verses.restored: Because this is the covenant that I will covenant with the house of Israel after those days, says Lord: giving my laws into their mind, I will also write them upon their hearts; and I will be to them Divine, and they will be to me people.

familiar.text: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

modern.text: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.

original.text: ὅτι αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν.

verses.restored: And they shall not teach each one one's citizen and each one one's sibling, saying, Know the Lord, because all will know me, from small to great of them.

familiar.text: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

modern.text: No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.

original.text: καὶ οὐ μὴ διδάξωσιν ἕκαστος τὸν πολίτην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, λέγων· Γνῶθι τὸν κύριον, ὅτι πάντες εἰδήσουσίν με ἀπὸ ⸀μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: Because I will be merciful to their injustices, and their sins/misalignments I will certainly remember no more.

familiar.text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

modern.text: For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”

original.text: ὅτι ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ⸀αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθῶ ἔτι.

verses.restored: In saying new, he has made the first old; but what is becoming old and aging is near disappearance.

familiar.text: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

modern.text: By speaking of a new covenant, He has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.

original.text: ἐν τῷ λέγειν Καινὴν πεπαλαίωκεν τὴν πρώτην, τὸ δὲ παλαιούμενον καὶ γηράσκον ἐγγὺς ἀφανισμοῦ.

translation_notes: New covenant is quoted from Jeremiah to Israel and Judah; do not erase its Jewish addressees.
Copy/shadow language describes cultic pattern relation, not contempt for earthly temple or Jewish worship.
The covenant promise centers internal Torah, knowing the Lord, mercy, and non-remembrance of sins.
safety_note: Hebrews 8 is often misused supersessionistically. The source text itself quotes a covenant promised to house of Israel and house of Judah; restoration must preserve that continuity.
